fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.description: A frontline warrior. High HP, reliable melee, hard to put down.

ability.name: Power Attack
ability.description: Strike for double damage dice at -2 to hit.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: A nimble skirmisher. Hits hard from the shadows and pockets extra coin.

ability.name: Sneak Attack
ability.description: Your next hit is an automatic critical.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.description: A glass cannon. Low HP, devastating magic, learns fast.

ability.name: Fireball
ability.description: Hurl a burst of flame for heavy guaranteed damage.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: A durable support. Heals in a pinch and cheats death once a day.

passive.name: Divine Favor
passive.description: Survive one otherwise-lethal hit per day at 1 HP.
